content.value: A 40 mm diameter solid steel shaft, used as a torque transmitter, is replaced with a hollow shaft having a 40 mm OD and a 36 mm ID. If both materials have the same strength, what is the percentage reduction in torque transmission? What is the percentage reduction in shaft weight?

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2021
